utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just send me the first repair on the list and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive. What’s the first repair on the list, and I can come by today with a few tools if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring a spare extension cord and help with the heavier stuff. Point me to whatever needs moving first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. Bring the extension cord and start with the old shelving by the back wall; I’ll point out the heavier pieces when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the house list and the order, so the main thing is matching people to addresses without overlaps. If you’ve got time, send me any updates from your side and I’ll plug them in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together, but I can send along any updates I hear and help keep track of overlaps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word and make sure everyone knows when and where it’s happening. I’m helping with the repair drive setup too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik. Send me any updates as they come in, and I’ll plug them into the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you heading over for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m thinking of swinging by around 2, when they start sorting things at the community hall. I’m still checking who’s handling drop-offs, but I can ask around and tell you what I find.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ve got the list, but I need the final house order and any updates before I can route anyone efficiently. Send me what changed, and I’ll slot it in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They’re still collecting tools and supplies over by the community hall, and a few folks said they’d help sort everything this afternoon. I haven’t heard a final house order yet, though.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We still need someone to sort the loose boards and another pair of hands for the east fence. If you can bring your tools today, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the details, but I can bring my tools today. Do you want me on the loose boards or the east fence?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m lining up the first houses now. Send me any updates from your side and I’ll fold them in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll send anything I hear. What time do you want me to head over to the community hall?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, just tell me the first thing that needs doing and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word and make sure everyone knows when and where it’s happening. First thing, let’s get the setup area ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive. What still needs doing, and where can I help? I’ve got a few tools and can come by today.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Could you bring the tools and help set up the repair station today? I still need a hand sorting supplies and checking what needs fixing.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
